title: [Feature/Audio]: 10-Band Graphic Equalizer with Complex Magnitude and Phase Bode Plot Analyzer
body:
## Problem
Audio engineers tune parametric/graphic EQs by inspecting not only combined decibel magnitude curves across ISO octave bands (`31Hz`–`16kHz`), but also nonlinear **phase shift** and group delay introduced by cascaded IIR biquad filters—analytical insight ArcadeVerse's audio tools do not yet compute.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 270+ LOC of complex IIR transfer math, Web Audio graph & Canvas analyzer):**
   - Create `assets/js/bode-graphic-eq.js`:
     - Build live Web Audio `BiquadFilterNode` 10-band cascade (`31.5`, `63`, `125`, `250`, `500`, `1k`, `2k`, `4k`, `8k`, `16k Hz` peaking + optional shelving modes) fed by built-in procedural pink-noise, sawtooth pad, and drum-loop synth sources (no external audio files).
     - Implement exact **digital biquad transfer function evaluator** `H(z) = (b0 + b1*z^-1 + b2*z^-2) / (1 + a1*z^-1 + a2*z^-2)` evaluating `z = exp(j*omega)` across logarithmic frequency bins `[20Hz..20kHz]`, computing exact total cascaded Magnitude (`dB`) and Unwrapped Phase (`degrees`), plus `AnalyserNode` live FFT spectrum overlay!
     - Include interactive draggable band handles directly on the Bode Canvas, `Q`-factor global/per-band slider, Bypass A/B switch, and EQ presets (`Vocal Presence`, `Warm Bass`, `Telephone Bandpass`, `Scooped V`).
   - Create `assets/css/bode-graphic-eq.css`:
     - Studio rack layout pairing logarithmic Canvas Magnitude + Phase Bode plots above 10 precision vertical faders and A/B trim meters.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API/2D Canvas, zero external DSP libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-bode-graphic-eq.js` validating biquad coefficient formulas (`Audio EQ Cookbook`), flat 0dB unity gain invariant (`|H(z)| == 1.0`), exact peak boost/cut dB matching center frequency, and phase shift bounds.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cascaded biquad complex transfer math plots exact composite Magnitude (dB) and Phase curves across 20Hz–20kHz.
- [ ] Real-time Web Audio playback and live FFT spectrum reflect all 10 EQ faders and A/B bypass without zipper clicks.
- [ ] Dragging nodes directly on the Bode plot or adjusting vertical faders syncs smoothly.
- [ ] Implementation exceeds 270 meaningful lines across isolated files without modifying protected files.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-bode-graphic-eq.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Mid-Side Stereo Width Processor with Vectorscope Goniometer and Phase Meter
body:
## Problem
Stereo mastering relies on decomposing `L/R` signals into Mid `(L+R)/sqrt(2)` and Side `(L-R)/sqrt(2)` channels, shaping stereo width safely, and catching destructive phase cancellation with a Lissajous Goniometer and Phase Correlation Meter (`-1..+1`)—a pro-audio toolset ArcadeVerse lacks.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 260+ LOC of M/S DSP matrix, vectorscope renderer & UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/midside-goniometer.js`:
     - Build Web Audio `ChannelSplitterNode` -> Gain M/S Sum-Difference Matrix (`M = 0.5*(L+R)`, `S = 0.5*(L-R)`, adjustable Mid Gain, Side Gain / Width `0%..200%`, plus Bass Mono Crossover filter keeping sub `< 120Hz` centered!) -> Recombination Matrix (`L' = M+S`, `R' = M-S`).
     - Include built-in stereo test generators (dual-detuned chorused pad, ping-pong delay synth, Haas-effect stereo click, and 180-degree inverted phase fault test!) using pure Web Audio.
     - Render real-time Canvas **45-degree rotated Lissajous Goniometer** (phosphor persistence trail showing vertical mono vs horizontal anti-phase lobes) alongside a real-time **Pearson Phase Correlation Bar** (`-1.0` red out-of-phase -> `+1.0` green mono-compatible) and Mid/Side RMS gauges.
   - Create `assets/css/midside-goniometer.css`:
     - Mastering console layout featuring polar goniometer radar grid, correlation meter, Mid/Side gain faders, Mono-Bass cutoff knob, and Solo Mid / Solo Side / Invert Polarity toggles.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API/2D Canvas, zero external DSP plugins, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-midside-goniometer.js` validating mathematical M/S encode/decode invertibility (`reconstruct(encode(L,R)) == (L,R)`), Pearson correlation exact results (`+1` for `L==R`, `0` orthogonal, `-1` for `L==-R`), and stereo width scaling invariants.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Mid-Side encoding, width scaling, Mono-Bass crossover, and Solo Mid/Side monitoring operate smoothly in real time.
- [ ] Phosphor Lissajous Goniometer and Phase Correlation meter accurately distinguish mono, wide stereo, and out-of-phase audio.
- [ ] Built-in stereo/anti-phase test synths let users hear and see phase cancellation immediately.
- [ ] Code spans 260+ meaningful lines across isolated files without touching protected core files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-midside-goniometer.js` passes under `node`.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Broadcast K-Weighted LUFS Loudness Meter and True-Peak Headroom Analyzer
body:
## Problem
Streaming platforms and broadcast television regulate audio levels using **ITU-R BS.1770 K-Weighted LUFS** (Momentary 400ms, Short-Term 3s, Integrated gated loudness, LRA Loudness Range) and oversampled True-Peak (`dBTP`) meters—standards completely unrepresented in ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 270+ LOC of BS.1770 K-weighting filters, gating math & broadcast UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/lufs-loudness-meter.js`:
     - Implement authentic two-stage **ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-Weighting IIR filter cascade** (Stage 1: +4dB high-shelf head acoustics pre-filter; Stage 2: 38Hz RLB high-pass filter) plus 4x linear/polyphase **True-Peak inter-sample interpolator** detecting hidden peaks above `0 dBFS`.
     - Compute Momentary (`400ms` sliding mean square), Short-Term (`3s`), Dual-Threshold Relative/Absolute Gated **Integrated LUFS**, Loudness Range (`LRA` 10th–95th percentile LU), and compliance vs platform targets (`-14 LUFS Spotify/YouTube`, `-16 Apple`, `-23 EBU R128`, `-24 ATSC`).
     - Include built-in dynamic reference signals (compressed synth master, wide dynamic classical chime, clipped hot sine burst) playable via Web Audio or analyzable offline with scrolling LUFS History Chart.
   - Create `assets/css/lufs-loudness-meter.css`:
     - Broadcast mastering meter bridge with color-zoned LUFS vertical bargraphs, platform target indicator line, True-Peak clip LEDs, and Integrated Reset button.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API/2D Canvas, zero external metering packages, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-lufs-loudness-meter.js` verifying `0 dBFS` 1kHz full-scale sine wave reference (`~ -0.691` or exact ITU BS.1770 calibration constant `-3.01 LKFS` / `-0.691 + 10*log10(meanSq)` check), `-70 LKFS` absolute gate rejection, and 4x oversampled True-Peak detection on shifted fractional-sample impulses.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] K-weighting filter cascade, Momentary/Short-Term/Integrated gated LUFS, and LRA compute accurately per BS.1770 principles.
- [ ] True-Peak oversampling detects inter-sample clipping missed by naive sample peak meters.
- [ ] Platform target overlays (`-14`, `-16`, `-23`, `-24 LUFS`) dynamically flag over-loud or compliant audio.
- [ ] Code spans 270+ meaningful lines across isolated files without modifying protected root files.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-lufs-loudness-meter.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Dual-Tone DTMF Telephony Keypad Synthesizer and Goertzel Frequency Decoder
body:
## Problem
Touch-tone telephony (`DTMF`) encodes digits `0–9, A–D, *, #` as overlapping pairs of low/high sine frequencies (`697–941Hz` + `1209–1633Hz`) decoded efficiently using the single-bin **Goertzel DSP algorithm** rather than full FFTs—an iconic signal-processing workflow ArcadeVerse lacks.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 260+ LOC of DTMF encoder, Goertzel DSP decoder & spectrogram UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/dtmf-goertzel-lab.js`:
     - Implement canonical ITU-T Q.23 DTMF 4x4 frequency matrix synthesizer (dual phase-continuous oscillators + optional injected Gaussian Line Noise & Hum interference toggles so users can stress-test decoding!).
     - Implement pure-JS **Goertzel single-frequency DFT bank** across all 8 DTMF tones (`697, 770, 852, 941, 1209, 1336, 1477, 1633 Hz`) plus second-harmonic speech-immunity twist check (`row/col ratio` and SNR floor verification) to decode arbitrary audio sample blocks or pre-dialed tone sequences cleanly!
     - Render real-time Canvas 8-bar Goertzel Energy Meter, Dual-Sine Waveform oscilloscope, and decoded dial-string readout alongside an interactive 16-key Telephony Keypad.
   - Create `assets/css/dtmf-goertzel-lab.css`:
     - Retro telecom central-office test rig layout with tactile 4x4 keypad, SNR noise injection slider, Batch Sequence Dialer input, and live Goertzel bin bar charts.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/Web Audio API/2D Canvas, zero external DSP dependencies, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-dtmf-goertzel-lab.js` asserting all 16 DTMF digit round-trips cleanly decode under quiet and moderate AWGN noise (`SNR >= 6 dB`), verifying twist rejection on unbalanced bogus tones, and validating silence/noise false-positive rejection.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Interactive Sweep-Line Bentley-Ottmann Segment Intersection Debugger

Finding all `k` intersections among `N` line segments drops from brute-force `O(N^2)` to output-sensitive `O((N+k) log N)` via the classic **Bentley-Ottmann Sweep-Line Algorithm**—an algorithm packed with subtle geometric degeneracies that makes an exceptional interactive debugger.
